unit.title: Number Trail
unit.situation: Toto follows number signs on a trail.

lessons.title: Lesson 1 — Meet the Trail Numbers
lessons.can_do: I can see and say numbers 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5.
target_language: zero, one, two, three, four, five
lessons.do: Point to each sign. Count with Toto. Match each number to the picture group.

lessons.title: Lesson 2 — More Number Signs
lessons.can_do: I can see and say numbers 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10.
story_lines: Emma and Toto walk on the trail.
lessons.do: Use the checkpoint cards. Count the objects and choose the matching number.

lessons.title: Lesson 3 — How Many?
lessons.can_do: I can ask and answer “How many?” with numbers 1–10.
story_lines: Mia sees flowers on the trail.
lessons.do: Ask and answer with the counting board. Use short answers only.

lessons.title: Lesson 4 — Big Number Signs
lessons.can_do: I can see and say numbers 11, 12, 13, 14, and 15.
story_lines: The trail goes into the trees.
They count leaves, stars, flowers, stones, and flags.
lessons.do: Use the nature station. Match 11–15 to the correct object groups.

lessons.title: Lesson 5 — To Twenty
lessons.can_do: I can see and say numbers 16, 17, 18, 19, and 20.
story_lines: The friends are near the finish.
The friends say, “We can count to twenty!”
lessons.do: Look at the number wall. Count slowly. Touch each object as you count.

lessons.title: Lesson 6 — One Star, Two Stars
lessons.focus: one and more than one; plural -s noticing
lessons.can_do: I can notice one thing and more than one thing.
story_lines: The friends sort one and more than one.
lessons.do: Sort picture cards into “one” and “more than one.” Notice the small -s sound in many words.

lessons.title: Lesson 7 — Number Challenge
lessons.focus: unit review: 0–20, How many?, one/more than one
lessons.can_do: I can complete a number challenge with Toto.
story_lines: It is the final number challenge.
Toto sits in the middle of the trail map.
The friends say, “Great job! We can count!”
lessons.do: Move around the review map. Count, ask, answer, and check.

watch.title: Watch — Toto’s Number Trail
script_lines: The signs go on: six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
More signs: eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen.
Final signs: sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty.

project.title: Final Project — My Number Challenge Card
project.output: Learners make a simple number challenge card with 2–4 counted picture groups and short oral lines.
steps: Choose two, three, or four numbers from 0–20.
Draw simple object groups: stars, balls, flowers, books, apples, bags, or pencils.
Write or place the matching numerals.
Ask “How many?” for one picture group.
